rows.en: "Parallel universes"... Ours is not the only universe in existence.
Many universes exist, and each one has its own, very similar "Earth."
They were worlds that would never cross paths.
Until that "Anomaly" occurred...
The "Anomaly" struck the Earth of every universe at almost the same moment.
Suddenly, cracks ran across the sky, and a vortex of darkness assailed the Earth.
Everything on the planet was swept up and vanished into the vortex.
Civilizations, living things, even minds and memories... Every last thing...
It was all drawn into "another dimension" outside every universe, where it formed a new world.
A world where the parallel universes became one...
Whether by chance or by destiny, the heroes drawn into this strange world have joined forces...
...and now, they set out to act. To save the Earth.
...Looks like another one just showed up.
That makes four now...
...This one's a different type from us.
Are you all right!? Hang in there!!
...Did the shock of getting pulled in knock them out?
...Ugh.
Looks like they've just passed out.
Hey! Can you hear us?
All right, they'll be fine now!
Looks like you're awake.
...What?
What... is this place...!?
Wh-what are you guys!?
Whoa, calm down. You're a "hero" too, aren't you?
We're heroes too, same as you.
Heroes...? I don't know any of you!
That goes both ways.
Seems each of us got pulled in here from a different world, too.
Same goes for you, right?
...Pulled in?
Ah... yeah, that's right... I remember now...
I was training on Planet K76...
Suddenly, a dark hole opened in the sky, and a violent storm kicked up.
The moment I took off to find out what was causing it, the storm got stronger...
And I... into that storm...
I see... Just like what happened to us.
By the way, you don't seem to be a Kamen Rider or a mobile suit...
Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Zero... Ultraman Zero.
I'm an Ultra Warrior, a member of the Space Garrison who protects peace in the universe.
Gotcha. So in Zero's world, the Ultra Warriors are the heroes.
Being called a hero to my face is kinda embarrassing, but yeah, that's about the size of it.
I'm Kamen Rider OOO. I want to help as many people as I possibly can.
Nice to meet you, Zero!!
Good to meet you too.
I'm Kamen Rider W (Double), a hard-boiled private eye who protects the peace of Fuuto.
Space and Fuuto are on different scales, but we share the same love of peace.
I'm counting on you.
I don't really get what's going on, but... well, nice to meet you anyway!
I'm Nu Gundam. I commanded a combat unit attached to Londo Bell...
...and fought the Zeon remnants.
Put simply, Zero, I'm just like you: a warrior fighting for peace in the universe.
I see... You seem like someone I can rely on.
By the way, where exactly are we?
This place seems to be pieced together from bits of various facilities and bases that got pulled in.
But we don't know anything beyond that.
And is there a way back to our own worlds?
Well... right now, we don't know of one.
I see... I'd hoped I could contact the other Ultra Warriors, but from the sound of it...
Yeah. We've got no way to contact our original worlds, either...
But that doesn't mean we're sitting on our hands. We're planning to go investigate.
Investigate?
Further in, there's something like a gate linking spaces together. Seems it leads somewhere else.
If we check it out, we might learn something.
I see... My comrades might be out there too.
Let's look for them together. There's a buddy of mine I got separated from, too.
The guy who's just a hand!!
Just a hand?
Yeah... It's a long story, but he's only a hand right now.
I mean, he looks weird, but he's a good guy at heart. Really!
All kinds of worlds have ended up in one place. Whoever shows up, it won't surprise me.
W's right. As fellow heroes, I'm sure we can understand each other.
Got it! Right now, what matters is that we join forces.
All right, I'm gonna do everything I can!!

notes.note: No speakers recovered for this slice; speakers inferred from voice: OOO polite/kimi, W (Shotaro) rough -nee/-ze, Nu Gundam calm commander, Zero the newcomer. English kept speaker-neutral where possible.
Newcomer's identity not yet known to speakers; used 'this one' / 'them' for the unconscious Zero (rows 0.21, 0.23, 0.25, 0.28) rather than 'he'.
Literal is 'do you recognize/understand us?' as a consciousness check on a stranger; rendered as 'Can you hear us?'.
Source trails off mid-sentence (Zero recounting being caught in the storm); kept unfinished.
Source shows the reading of W in parentheses; kept as 'Kamen Rider W (Double)' for this first introduction only.
Source has an apparent typo (overturn-kanji instead of love-kanji before 'suru'); translated as 'love of peace'.
Direction: W asking Zero for cooperation -> 'I'm counting on you.'
Londo Bell / Zeon: standard Gundam English names, not in glossary.
Source typo (sareta written as sareta-ra); read as 'reconstructed'.
Speaker (Zero) subject unspecified; 'our own worlds' chosen since all four come from different worlds.
OOO's separated partner is Ankh (row 0.81 'just a hand'); Ankh is male per glossary so 'he' used in 0.83-0.84.
Speaker inferred as W because the next line says 'W's right'.
Source ends with a trailing line break; dropped. Speaker likely Zero (first-person resolve) but not certain.
proofread: "dimensional space" dropped the other/different-dimension sense; aligned with story_024/025 "another dimension".
